title: Research: exact COPY112 floor for tetrad-local P112 masked decoders
body:
## Result and scope

Adds one independently runnable package, `research/p112-tetrad-local-decoder/`, on exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.

**Scoped negative result; no new kappa, supplier, or frontier change.** For P112 masked decoders, require that each paid rank-one term has at least one actual nonzero support confined to one canonical eight-line tetrad. The other support is arbitrary; orientation may vary per term; arbitrary real/complex coefficients, cancellations, overcomplete term counts, and unrestricted cost-zero terms are allowed.

- Total copied pairing rank is at least **112**, and every paid term has rank at most **four**.
- Sharp masked attainment: **56 rank-two terms**, using an exact four-column identity on each eight-line block. Sharp all-pairs attainment: 112 singleton-row terms.
- The proof uses the rank demand of 28 disjoint orthogonal four-frames, not eight-term rigidity.
- Escaping to cost at most64 requires nonlocal frame excess at least48; cost below64 requires at least49. The existing coordinate decoder attains excess48.
- Under the explicitly retained coverage law, minimum centre charge112 gives deficit `-112/9` and zero-saving moment `585/584 > 1`. This rejects every complete profile under that law before synthesis; no hypothetical incomplete invoice is presented as a supplier.

This is the scoped effective-rank obstruction alternative of `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, **not** satisfaction of the positive 5% mechanism gate. Shared-copy pricing, different coverage laws, and nonlocal alphabets remain outside the theorem.

## Exact evidence and reproduction

Final local verification on macOS arm64 / CPython3.12.12, standard library:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-local-decoder
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/p112-tetrad-local-decoder/verify.py --json
```

Both passed (measured wall times **0.50s** registered replay, **0.41s** direct smoke):

```text
PASS_P112_TETRAD_LOCAL_DECODER blocks=14 classes=28 supports=917504 copy_floor=112 rank_cap=4 masked_terms=56 escape=48 moment0=585/584 controls=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p112-tetrad-local-decoder outcome=negative-result
```

The checker reconstructs E8 independently, checks all917,504 within-block support pairs, full-block label ranks, all required masked entries, the complete small block identities, all-pairs attainment, and six scope/failure controls. Complex cancellation is checked through separate integer real/imaginary arrays. README contains the universal written argument extending the finite geometry to arbitrary opposite supports and coefficients. No formal proof, native physical realization, hosted CI result, or full selected cold replay is claimed.

## Sources, novelty limits, and next questions

TASK.json records the assigned card and refined negative-result scope; SOURCES.json pins the base, selected record, task catalogue, and predecessor geometry/coverage notes; VERIFY.json registers replay. Frozen sources and selected evidence are unchanged.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR717 for the B14 support-pair model, the frame-pair/rank-eight-rigidity authors for geometry and earlier results, Aaron Wang/Navinor PR1226 and masked-root-star-assembly for frame-demand arguments, and PR1012/local-word-ceiling authors for coverage. Closest distinct live PRs inspected are PR1633 (outside-code rank budgets, head `652264fa1f70820139b2730363a0056b7fadc689`) and PR1866 (mixed rank-six bilinear block, head `7d22d1d51eb6c0bc040f8181b6c5f83e051fb234`). Neither is a proof dependency.

Final cached overlap search covered543 open PRs at13:23:53Z and529 discussion records at13:25:07Z on2026-10-14; targeted locality terms matched only this package. This does not establish novelty and excludes arbitrary diffs/nested files. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1884.

Open next questions identify two-tetrad support escape witnesses and whether excess49 can be realized by an exact lower-cost decoder with a fully charged physical interface.

Prepared for Adam Gall with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in scope, proof, implementation, review, and documentation. Apache-2.0.
